items.title: Costco (COST) Pushes Further Into GLP 1 Weight Loss Prescriptions
items.summary: Costco Wholesale is accelerating its entry into the weight loss drug market through GLP-1 prescriptions and related healthcare services. The company is moving alongside Walmart and Amazon as retailers compete to attract customers seeking access to these treatments. Industry cutbacks on employer drug coverage are pushing more patients toward direct-to-consumer fulfillment programs.
